mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_allocation (org_unit_id, account_category, fiscal_year, amount) VALUES (#{orgUnitId}, #{accountCategory}, #{fiscalYear}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.org_unit_id, a.account_category, a.fiscal_year, a.amount, o.name AS org_unit_name FROM budget_allocation a JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = a.org_unit_id WHERE a.org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId} AND a.fiscal_year = #{fiscalYear} ORDER BY a.account_category
